mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates severe labor market deterioration that triggers recessionary equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction that forces equity sell-offs, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing weakness that precedes earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 550 thousand units signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 550.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation rise (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate active monetary tightening that increases real rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL-FEDFUNDS interaction fails to produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market tightness regimes, strong employment growth (PAYEMS) signals persistent wage pressures that trigger aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during labor market tightness when PAYEMS exceeds 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines.
